verdict.rationale: Base44 docs state that every new app ships with built-in login, register, forgot-password and reset-password pages. Those pages can be customized, and apps can offer multiple sign-up methods such as email and Google. This means the builder scaffolds the auth flow itself. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported social providers beyond Google, provider configuration details, and independent hands-on corroboration of the scaffolded auth flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add user sign-up and login (email, social providers) scaffolded by the builder

citations.quote: All new Base44 apps come with custom login pages built in. You get ready-made login, register, forgot password, and reset password pages that you can customize
You can offer multiple ways for people to sign up, such as email, Google, or other providers, so that login stays simple, secure, and familiar.
They live inside your app, so you can customize the design, translate them into any language, and add your own branding.
